I keep having dreams where a particular former FWB keeps showing up and gets romantic with me again.   I don't want to keep dreaming of him. Is there a way to make it stop?
I used this full moon as a chance to make a health jar for me and my sister who are heading back to school

How do I thank Freya for listening to me?
So, the sad fact is is that my oldest cat is going to have to be put down later this week.   I got the message from my parents that he wasn't eating, or doing too well in general, and I broke down in front of my altar and asked for his safe passage to the other side.  I called out for Freya and I believe she answered me because she made my candle flame flicker when I asked.  How do I give thanks to her for hearing my prayers?

Can I just stop existing for 2 seconds?
As I'm sure everyone is probably aware, 2020 just fucking sucks.  I am exhausted beyond the point of being tired.   My parents put my cat down and I didn't get a chance to say my final goodbyes because there was a complication with his medicine.   I cried so much that I blocked my tear duct and had to live with a swollen eye for a few days.  Before that though, I have been covering multiple shifts for my job because we're horrendously understaffed. I have had the misfortune of being yelled at by a demeaning ableist old man who, of course, refused to wear his mask. Within the same HOUR, I got called a communist because another man refused to wear a mask as well.  What's even better is that corporate still wants me to serve these fuckers because they're still "paying customers".  I'm done. I'm sick to death of these fucking idiots. I feel like nothing is going to get better.   Vote they say. Vote vote vote vote vote. Of course I'm going to vote but it feels like I'm fighting a losing battle. The odds seem to be stacked against us.   No one cares about each other so why should I care about them?  I wish I wasn't dealing with this bullshit. I wish that I wasn't even existing at this point. I hate it here. I hate this stupid country.
I'm really proud of how this turned out

I'm being gaslit by my job So I work for a chain coffee place, though it's more popular in the Midwest. Those who know know.   Not once, not twice, not even three times, they've changed the schedule for when I'm supposed to work. This schedule had been posted TWO WEEKS before and I'm very careful to write every single shift down into my planner.  I even check the copy of the schedule on the bulletin board to see what time I'm supposed to come in the next day.  But, when I wake up, I get twenty texts from my manager saying that I'm an hour late for my shift! I check again on the schedule and, sure enough, I'm an hour late.   I wake up at 5:30 nearly every morning and drag my tired ass out of bed, not even having enough time to eat breakfast, to drive ten minutes to serve grumpy old people their hot black coffees for 3 dollars a pop.  We also serve bagels as well so it's basically me and a few other sandwich makers running around doing 34 tasks at once while the orders keep coming in.  I know the stress of working a fast-paced food job, I get it. But between the changing the schedule right under my nose without telling anyone, to being yelled at by old men who refuse to wear a mask, to the fact that I make EIGHT TWENTY-FIVE an hour is about making me want to have a mental breakdown.  I also have college classes I still need to attend and I've let my boss know this and even changed my availability FOUR TIMES, yet she still schedules me during my class hours....   I'm fucking done.
